source: Pluralit Core Team - Compensation Structure 2026, 'Plantilla de Evaluación 360'. Dimensions and competencies follow that document's sections: Sección I (Expertise Técnico) and Sección II A (Competencias Blandas & Valores Pluralit). Sección II B is qualitative and lives in questions.json as qualitative_fixed.

delivery.1: Requires frequent reminders to complete assigned tasks and/or does not deliver on time and to standard. Communication about obstacles tends to be late, needing help to finish. Quality of delivered work does not meet expectations.
delivery.2: Consistently meets agreed tasks. Delivers results at the expected quality with minimal corrections. Identifies obstacles early and acts autonomously to minimise their impact.
delivery.3: Is a standard of excellence; output is impeccable and always on time. Anticipates any risk of delay with solid contingency plans, achieving exceptional results without external follow-up.

management_impact.1: Needs frequent guidance to progress on complex tasks or to take operational decisions. Tends to focus on completing the immediate task without evaluating the impact on other areas or the underlying customer problem.
management_impact.2: Takes ownership of their matters and makes data-grounded decisions that benefit the business. Collaborates openly with peers, prioritises the customer experience and proposes improvements to simplify their processes.
management_impact.3: Acts with full strategic autonomy, aligning stakeholders and celebrating collective success. Is a reference who designs systems independent of their presence, innovates for the organisation and sustains positive energy in the face of adversity.

dimensions.label: Delivery
dimensions.note: Sección I: Expertise Técnico — Capacidad de Delivery only

dimensions.label: Soft Skills & Pluralit Values
dimensions.note: Sección II A: Autonomía, Decisión, Innovación, Impacto Sistémico, Cliente

competencies.name: Delivery
competencies.definition: Ability to execute what has been agreed and deliver tangible results with quality and within defined timelines.

items.label: Commitment Fulfilment
items.prompt: Does {subject} consistently meet agreed deadlines for their deliverables without the need for constant reminders?
items.self_prompt: Do you consistently meet agreed deadlines for your deliverables without needing constant reminders?

items.label: Quality and Excellence
items.prompt: Does the final outcome of {subject}'s work meet the expected quality standards, requiring minimal corrections or revisions?
items.self_prompt: Does the final outcome of your work meet the expected quality standards, requiring minimal corrections or revisions?

items.label: Obstacle Management
items.prompt: In the event of delays or unforeseen issues, does {subject} communicate risks in a timely manner and propose an action plan to minimise the impact on the final outcome?
items.self_prompt: When delays or unforeseen issues come up, do you communicate the risk in good time and propose an action plan to minimise the impact on the final outcome?

competencies.name: Level of Autonomy
competencies.definition: Ability to progress without direct supervision.

items.label: End-to-End Management
items.prompt: Does {subject} follow up on their tasks with attention to detail without the need for constant reminders?
items.self_prompt: Do you follow up on your tasks with attention to detail without needing constant reminders?

items.label: Proactivity
items.prompt: Does {subject} act before circumstances require it in order to prevent problems or create opportunities?
items.self_prompt: Do you act before circumstances require it, in order to prevent problems or create opportunities?

items.label: Accountability (Ownership)
items.prompt: Does {subject} take full ownership of the matters within their area, ensuring that results are achieved?
items.self_prompt: Do you take full ownership of the matters within your area, making sure results are achieved?

competencies.section: II A.2 Madurez en Toma de Decisiones
competencies.name: Maturity in Decision-Making

items.label: Quality of Decisions
items.prompt: Does {subject} make decisions based on data and sound reasoning that benefit the business in the long term?
items.self_prompt: Do you make decisions based on data and sound reasoning that benefit the business in the long term?

items.label: Independence of Judgement
items.prompt: Is {subject} able to decide on a course of action in situations of uncertainty without escalating operational matters to their manager?
items.self_prompt: Are you able to decide on a course of action in situations of uncertainty, without escalating operational matters to your manager?

items.label: Impact Analysis
items.prompt: Before making decisions, does {subject} assess the impact their actions will have on other areas of the organisation?
items.self_prompt: Before making decisions, do you assess the impact your actions will have on other areas of the organisation?

competencies.name: Ability to Innovate and Improve the System
competencies.definition: Process evolution and the ability to make oneself replaceable.

items.label: Simplification and Technology
items.prompt: Does {subject} propose the use of technology or new methodologies to optimise tasks and reduce complexity?
items.self_prompt: Do you propose the use of technology or new methodologies to optimise tasks and reduce complexity?

items.label: Challenging the Status Quo
items.prompt: Does {subject} constructively question existing processes in order to propose more effective ways of working?
items.self_prompt: Do you constructively question existing processes in order to propose more effective ways of working?

items.label: Knowledge Transfer
items.prompt: Does {subject} document and share their processes in such a way that others can execute them, making the system independent of their physical presence?
items.self_prompt: Do you document and share your processes in such a way that others can execute them, making the system independent of your physical presence?

items.label: Strategic Vision
items.prompt: Are {subject}'s actions and plans aligned with the company's overall objectives, rather than solely with their individual tasks?
items.self_prompt: Are your actions and plans aligned with the company's overall objectives, rather than solely with your individual tasks?

items.label: Results Orientation
items.prompt: Does {subject} insist on reaching the highest standards of excellence to ensure the business grows?
items.self_prompt: Do you insist on reaching the highest standards of excellence to ensure the business grows?

items.label: Influence and Alignment
items.prompt: Is {subject} able to align different stakeholders to ensure that a project progresses and delivers the expected impact?
items.self_prompt: Are you able to align different stakeholders to ensure that a project progresses and delivers the expected impact?

competencies.section: II A.5 Orientación al cliente externo e interno
competencies.name: Customer Orientation
competencies.definition: Acting client-centrically for internal and external customers.

items.label: Needs Identification
items.prompt: Does {subject} proactively seek to understand the underlying customer problem, involving the relevant areas before proposing a solution?
items.self_prompt: Do you proactively seek to understand the underlying customer problem, involving the relevant areas before proposing a solution?

items.label: Value Added
items.prompt: Do {subject}'s technical or process decisions consistently prioritise improving the end-user experience or the success of the internal customer?
items.self_prompt: Do your technical or process decisions consistently prioritise improving the end-user experience or the success of the internal customer?

items.label: Collaboration and Collective Success
items.prompt: Does {subject} act with integrity and genuinely support their peers to ensure the customer receives a coherent solution?
items.self_prompt: Do you act with integrity and genuinely support your peers so that the customer receives a coherent solution?
